time.desc: The company submitted overdue annual reports and quarterly reports to the regulatory agency and re-complied with the listing application requirements. The exchange confirmed compliance and closed the case.
The company appoints new independent directors, general counsel and senior vice president of corporate development
The company released quarterly unaudited financial results, with sales falling quarter-on-quarter and gross profit margin and net profit falling sharply.
The company discloses the size of cash and cash equivalents, bank debt and convertible bonds at the end of the quarter in its quarterly financial report
The company releases net sales performance guidance for the next quarter with its quarterly financial report.

The company's stock price plummeted after the company announced its quarterly financial report. Both revenue and earnings per share fell short of market expectations, and the full-year revenue forecast was significantly lowered.
The company disclosed to regulators that there were significant deficiencies in internal control over financial reporting and that it failed to operate effectively.
Company executives submit revised insider shareholding change report to regulators, supplementary disclosure of spouse’s indirect shareholdings

The company's co-founder and CEO was arrested by authorities and faces multiple criminal charges for allegedly illegally smuggling high-end technology chips to specific countries through a network of affiliated companies.
Company director resigns from board, company appoints acting chief compliance officer
The company's independent directors launched an independent investigation to verify employees' suspected smuggling of chips to specific countries.
Brokerage analysts downgraded the company's rating and target price, criticizing the company's passive compliance adjustments and failure to completely separate from those involved.

The company's board of directors announced the appointment of specific individuals to lead the internal investigation and disclosed that two employees and a contractor were indicted on suspicion of conspiring to violate export control regulations.
